description: A spinner (DESIGN.md, Spinner): a quarter arc in color (the accent by default, or a button's own content colour) over its TsuyaColors.track, turning once every 0.8 s. It keeps turning under reduced motion: its motion is the information. Announced alone as a progress indicator named label (the `loading` label by default); wrap it in `ExcludeSemantics` where another control, such as a loading Button, already announces its own state.

params.name: label
params.description: Names the wait; the `loading` label by default.

params.name: color
params.description: The arc's colour; the accent by default.
